ios.desc:
Metaballs were one of the first ways to model truly organic shapes in computer graphics, and now you can experience them in real-time, spatial 3D! Fuse together different blobby primitives and play with different materials. Unlock additional primitives, materials, and the ability to export your geometry with in-app purchase of Metaballs+ subscription. 

By the creator of Vibescape, Metaballs: Spatial was born out of a desire to create a hands-on modeling experience to take full advantage of visionOS 26's amazing new manipulation gestures. It's super fun to reach out and grab the shapes, and see the metaballs mesh smoothly update in real-time; something truly only possible on this platform! 

Free to play around with, subscription to unlock full feature-set (and support the development of these indie products!) And by popular demand, we've now included a one-time, life-time unlock in-app purchase!

Now supports USDZ export so you can view your models in XR as well as use them in other digital content creation apps, as well as STL export for 3D printing applications.

Terms of use: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

quotes.text:
I launched two apps for visionOS 26 this month:

Metaballs: Spatial, which is a really fun interactive sculpting app. Brand new app. Fast-follow update this week adds USDZ and STL export! https://apps.apple.com/us/app/metaballs/id6748781900

Vibescape: an immersive meditation app. This one is currently featured at the top of the App Store, yay! Launched as a day one app on Vision Pro, new update has what I think is the best immersive environment I've made yet that comes alive with music: https://apps.apple.com/us/app/vibescape/id6476827678

I'm also working on the next episode of Ice Moon — a YouTube series I'm doing on how to build immersive environments for Apple Vision Pro: https://youtube.com/playlist?list=PLHA_sJmXyiktWkqLnHEUj1k5hfQRBjBq_&si=yVZpC-oD2JAaBw3b
